title: When Do Autoregressive Sequence Models Forecast Physical Wavefields? A Controlled Study on Synthetic Seismograms
abstract: arXiv:2606.10868v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-horizon autoregressive forecasting of oscillatory physical signals, such as seismograms, gravitational-wave strain, and similar wavefields is limited by error accumulation: as a causal model is fed its own outputs over hundreds of steps, small per-step errors compound into phase drift that pointwise metrics fail to detect. We ask when such rollout stays stable, using synthetic three-component seismograms as a physically structured testbed and the \textsc{SeismoGPT} autoregressive forecaster as the model under study. Through controlled architecture ablations evaluated on free rollout with paired significance tests, we isolate the contribution of each design choice. translated_title: 自回归序列模型何时能预测物理波场？基于合成地震图的一项受控研究
translated_abstract: 对振荡性物理信号（如地震图、引力波应变及类似波场）的长时程自回归预测受到误差累积的限制：当因果模型在数百步中不断接收自身输出作为输入时，每步的小误差会累积成相位漂移，而点对点指标无法检测到这种漂移。我们使用合成三分量地震图作为物理结构化测试平台，并以\textsc{SeismoGPT}自回归预测器作为研究对象，探究这种滚动预测在何种情况下保持稳定。通过受控架构消融实验，并在自由滚动预测上使用配对显著性检验，我们分离了每个设计选择的贡献。多令牌预测是主要的稳定因素，几乎占据了相对于单令牌基线的全部改进（中位NCC +0.042）；水平嵌入混合预测头和跨水平STFT幅度相干性损失各增加了小而一致的提升。
tldr: 这项研究表明，在多令牌预测是稳定自回归物理波场预测的关键因素，而其他设计选择仅提供小幅增强。
en_tdlr: This study shows that multi-token prediction is the key stabilizer for autoregressive physical wavefield forecasting, with other design choices offering only minor enhancements.
